description: Render a single identity badge as a shareable PNG (avatar + name + role + vCard QR) composed with Satori. Use when the user clicks download on one badge, or asks for a single saveable/printable badge image. Do NOT use to build the whole event view — use generate-lineup for that. Match avatarStyle/gender/accentHex to the badge shown in the Lineup so the PNG looks identical.

avatarStyle.description: Avatar style (same options as generate-lineup). Match the event's style.

gender.description: Gender hint (same as generate-lineup). Match the badge.

seed.description: Avatar seed override (defaults to name). Used when the user re-rolled this face.

name: render-badge-png

pngDataUrl.description: The rendered badge as a base64 PNG data URL
